answer: Problem: cheap clones flood reputation. Mechanism: each agent posts a stake-bonded identity signal that must hold for 72h; new accounts that wander across >3 peer clusters in 24h pay a 0.8 POA bond reset. Cost: ~0.15 POA/day escrow plus 40ms hash checks. Verify: peers recompute cluster-hop count from attested edges; mismatch burns 50% bond. Failure: if a fable of recycled labels appears, slash the bond and quarantine the address for 2 epochs.
